Meals › Scanner
Roxgold SiteLife.
Catering: scanning meals.
At the restaurant entrance, check-in is often done
on a paper list.
Counts are approximate,
and nothing stops someone from coming through twice.
With Roxgold SiteLife, your phone becomes a scanner:
every meal is validated, counted and recorded.
Sign in with your catering account,
then tap the Meals tab.
Check your restaurant and the current meal:
breakfast, lunch or dinner.
Today's counters are shown.
The scanner starts: allow the camera,
then hold the resident's QR code in front of the lens.
Green screen and a beep: the meal is validated,
in the resident's name.
The resident can rate the meal in a moment,
or skip.
If they come back for the same meal:
orange screen, Already taken.
An unknown or forged QR code is refused:
red screen, Not recognised.
The history lists validated meals,
with the time and the restaurant.
And the counters update automatically.
One scan per meal, an accurate count,
and a record of every visit.
Roxgold SiteLife.
Have a good service!
